Job description Are you an ambitious Instrumentation Technician (E&I) from South Africa who is ready to build an international career in the Netherlands? Xelvin is looking for talented technicians who want to work in one of Europe's leading petrochemical environments. As an Instrumentation Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting instrumentation and electrical systems that are essential for safe and reliable plant operations. You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. Employment conditions At Xelvin, we do much more than help you find a job. We help you build a future in the Netherlands. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)

Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. You have: A recognised trade qualification in Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I), Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering. Experience as an Instrumentation Technician or E&I Technician. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. About the organisation Xelvin has over 20 years of experience in connecting technical professionals with leading companies throughout the Netherlands. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Xelvin provides comprehensive relocation assistance, from immigration support to housing and settling into Dutch life. Our client operates in one of Europe's largest petrochemical clusters and is committed to innovation, safety and sustainability. You will work with modern technologies in an international environment where technical expertise is highly valued.
